verdict.rationale: The only Apple-specific evidence is that Edge0 ships an on-device iPhone app built on Swift + MLX Swift, plus a Rust CLI/daemon/desktop app for macOS. That suggests an Apple-native inference path, but the evidence never explicitly describes Metal or ARM optimizations or any Apple Silicon speedup. Missing for 10: explicit Metal/GPU acceleration documentation, native ARM optimization claims, an Apple Silicon Mac inference backend description, and Apple Silicon benchmarks or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: iOS: on-device iPhone app (Swift + MLX Swift)
macOS: local CLI / daemon / desktop app (Rust)
